rules.warning: Resource rivalry and copying costs may differ; a physical commons is not interchangeable with a digital dependency.
Decision authority differs; do not transfer an intervention without identifying who can authorize it.
Forkability and costly or irreversible exit impose different burdens; technical copying does not establish social exit cost.
Custody differs; delegated maintainership, threshold approval, and compromised credentials are distinct access mechanisms.
Feedback timing differs; human adjudication and rapid automated responses need separate evidence.
